messages.subject: [Viennar-meetup] ViennaR Meetup - November
messages.body_plain:
Dear ViennaR members,

We are happy to announce Achim Zeileis and Joel Gotsch for our next
ViennaR meetup. This time the Meetup is hosted at Raiffeisen Bank
International (at Stadtpark, 1030 Vienna - "Skyroom").
This is a joint Meetup together with R-Ladies Vienna.

Topics:

1. Achim Zeileis: Distributional Regression Forests for Probabilistic
Modeling and Forecasting.

2. Joel Gotsch: Dynamic FX Margin Optimization

After the talks you are invited to join the networking session with
refreshments provided by our host RBI.

The meetup will take place
on Friday, November 29, 2019
at 6:00 PM
in Skyroom (Raiffeisen Bank International - Am Stadtpark 9, Wien).

See you soon!

Greetings,
ViennaR organizers
